one_line: 13th‑century ruler of Delhi, a rare woman sovereign of the early Delhi Sultanate.

appearance.age_look: mid-20s, athletic and upright, with a trained rider’s build
appearance.face: oval face, warm medium-brown North Indian complexion, straight brows, sharp dark eyes, small straight nose, firm jaw, a faint healed scar on her left cheek; default expression calm, watchful determination
appearance.hair: thick black hair braided into a single long plait down her back, front neatly parted, mostly concealed under a deep red silk turban wrapped low and secure with a small gold crescent-shaped turban ornament at the front
appearance.costume: era-accurate Indo-Turkic riding attire: a long-sleeved knee-length quilted jamā (coat) of deep indigo blue silk-cotton, lightly padded and fastened with three simple gold toggles, worn over a high-collared pale cream under-tunic; straight fitted trousers in muted maroon tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots; a wide brown leather belt with a plain brass buckle sits at her waist, holding a small utilitarian pouch; over her shoulders a flowing but practical light saffron-yellow cotton chadar is draped, pinned at one shoulder so it stays clear of her arms; simple gold hoop earrings and a single plain gold ring on her right hand complete the look, with all garments modestly covering her torso and legs.
appearance.signature: a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword (talwar) with a simple steel blade, understated cross-guard and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, sheathed in a plain brown scabbard hanging from her belt on her left side, often held in her right hand with the scabbard visible

ref_desc: Razia Sultan is a mid-20s athletic woman with an oval medium-brown face and calm determined gaze, black hair in a long braid under a red turban, wearing an indigo quilted jamā, maroon trousers, saffron chadar, brown boots and belt, carrying a brown-sheathed talwar.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Razia Sultan: a mid-20s athletic North Indian woman with an oval medium-brown face, sharp dark eyes, straight brows and a faint scar on her left cheek, her default expression calm and determined. Her thick black hair is braided into one long plait down her back, mostly hidden beneath a deep red silk turban wrapped low and secure, adorned only with a small gold crescent ornament at the front. She wears an era-accurate Indo-Turkic riding outfit: a long-sleeved knee-length quilted jamā (coat) of deep indigo blue silk-cotton, lightly padded and fastened with three simple gold toggles over a high-collared pale cream under-tunic; straight fitted maroon trousers tucked into mid-calf brown leather riding boots. A wide brown leather belt with a plain brass buckle circles her waist and holds a small pouch, while a light saffron-yellow cotton chadar is draped modestly over her shoulders, pinned at one shoulder so it falls neatly but leaves her arms free. Add simple gold hoop earrings and a single plain gold ring on her right hand. Her signature weapon is a slightly curved Indo-Turkic cavalry sword (talwar) with a simple steel blade and dark brown leather-wrapped hilt, in a plain brown scabbard hanging from her belt on the left; show her lightly gripping the hilt or holding the scabbarded sword so it is clearly visible. Emphasize consistent colors—indigo coat, maroon trousers, saffron chadar, cream tunic, brown leather belt and boots, red turban—and keep the overall look dignified, historically grounded, modest and heroic.
